# Visily

> Visily is an AI-powered UI design platform that transforms ideas into interactive prototypes through intelligent automation and real-time collaboration.

Visily provides a comprehensive suite of design tools including wireframing, prototyping, AI-powered design generation, and team collaboration features. The platform combines traditional design capabilities with cutting-edge AI to accelerate the design process for both designers and non-designers.

## Key Topics

- AI-powered design
- UI design
- Prototyping
- Wireframing
- Team collaboration
- Design automation
- Rapid prototyping
- Component library
- UI templates
- Mobile app design
- Web app design
- Real-time collaboration
- Screenshot editor
- Brainstorming tools
- Smart components

## Core Platform

- [Visily Web Application](https://app.visily.ai): Visily web application for UI design, prototyping, and wireframing
- [Visily Homepage](https://www.visily.ai): Visily homepage showcasing AI-powered UI design and prototyping platform
- [Pricing Plans](https://www.visily.ai/pricing): Visily pricing plans: Free, Pro, and Business tiers

## AI Design Tools

- [AI Design Tool](https://www.visily.ai/ai-design): Visily AI design tool converting text, images, and diagrams to UI
- [Screenshot Editor AI](https://www.visily.ai/screenshot-editor-ai): Visily's AI screenshot editor converting screenshots to editable designs

## Design & Prototyping Tools

- [Wireframing Tool](https://www.visily.ai/wireframe-tool): Visily's wireframing tool for creating app and website wireframes
- [Prototyping Tool](https://www.visily.ai/prototyping): Visily's prototyping tool with auto-prototype and smart components
- [Brainstorming Tools](https://www.visily.ai/brainstorming): Visily brainstorming tools with sticky notes and flowchart design

## Collaboration & Assets

- [Real-Time Collaboration Tool](https://www.visily.ai/collaboration): Visily's real-time design collaboration tool for teams
- [Component Library](https://www.visily.ai/component-library): Visily's component library with icons, images, and UI presets
- [Online Sticky Notes](https://www.visily.ai/online-sticky-notes): Visily's online sticky notes for design collaboration and brainstorming

## Templates & Presets

- [UI Templates Library](https://www.visily.ai/templates): Visily's library of 1500+ UI design templates and wireframes
- [Built-in Templates](https://www.visily.ai/built-in-template): Visily's customizable UI templates for web and mobile apps
